turns.prompt_text: I'm in an Ikea. Do these sensors require a home Smart hub? Attached 1 file. - 282c8010-fba1-4913-aee2-dbb7e1c47b86
turns.response_html:
The short answer is: it depends on how you want to use them.

Looking at your photo, those are the newer IKEA smart sensors (like the PARASOLL door/window sensor and VALLHORN motion sensor). Here is the breakdown of whether you need a hub:

1. No Hub Required (Direct Pairing)

If you just want the sensor to trigger a specific light (e.g., walk into a closet and the light turns on), you do not need a hub.

  • You can "steer" or pair these sensors directly to IKEA smart bulbs (TRÅDFRI).
  • The Catch: You won't get phone notifications, you can't set schedules, and you can't control them via an app or voice assistant.

2. Hub Required (Smart Features)

If you want to receive alerts on your phone ("The front door is open!") or integrate them into a larger system (like Apple Home, Google Home, or Alexa), you must have a hub.

  • IKEA’s Official Option: The DIRIGERA hub is the current standard. It replaced the older TRÅDFRI gateway.
  • Third-Party Options: Since these use Zigbee (and the newest ones support Matter over Thread), you can often use a non-IKEA hub you might already own, such as:
    • A Google Nest Hub (2nd Gen) or Nest Hub Max.
    • An Apple TV 4K (with Ethernet) or HomePod.
    • An Amazon Echo with a built-in Zigbee hub.

Quick Summary Table

FeatureNo HubWith Hub (DIRIGERA / Matter)
Control LightsYes (Directly paired)Yes
App ControlNoYes
Phone NotificationsNoYes
Automation/SchedulesNoYes

Pro-tip for your IKEA trip: If you're planning to build out a whole "smart" room, the DIRIGERA hub is usually worth the investment for the firmware updates alone, which keep the sensors from getting "buggy" over time.
